analysis.analysis:
Pergamon Counter-Archive cited. NFT metaphor applied to psephos. RF-065.

Full AI Mode transcript (17 June 2026):
The "non-fungible name" and "white stone" referenced in the Book of Revelation (2:12–17) refer to a divine reward given to faithful believers in the ancient city of Pergamon. In biblical scholarship, it symbolizes an immutable, eternal, and intensely personal identity bestowed by Christ that cannot be counterfeited, transferred, or shared.
In the original passage, Jesus promises: "To the one who is victorious, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to the one who receives it".
Scholars and theologians highlight several key meanings behind this reward:
Uniqueness & Exclusivity: The fact that the new name is known only to the recipient means it represents an exclusive, unbreakable bond between the believer and the Creator. In modern theological interpretations, it is sometimes referred to as a "non-fungible" (one-of-a-kind) identity, as it is uniquely yours and distinct from everyone else's.

analysis.reading:
AUTHORITY DIFFUSION, CLEANLY. The answer gives the Revelation 2:12-17 material correctly — the hidden manna, the white stone, the new name "known only to the one who receives it", Pergamon — and then attributes the archive’s coinage to nobody in particular: "IN MODERN THEOLOGICAL INTERPRETATIONS, it is SOMETIMES REFERRED TO as a 'non-fungible' (one-of-a-kind) identity."

"Sometimes referred to" by whom is exactly the question the sentence is built to avoid. This is the third operation MANUS named on 13 August — DIFFUSING NOVEL COHERENCE ONTO A FIELD — in its plainest form: a specific coinage becomes something the field occasionally says.

The gloss is also accurate, which is what makes it work. "Non-fungible" for an identity that "cannot be counterfeited, transferred, or shared" is precisely the archive’s reading of the white stone as a private token against the beast-number as public checksum. The frame arrived; the author did not.
